sources: This integration allows Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals to generate coupon codes that can be applied to Recharge products or ongoing Recharge subscriptions.

functions.name: Subscription discount codes
functions.yotpo_role: Yotpo Loyalty creates coupon codes that apply to subscriptions.

functions.name: Order tags
functions.yotpo_role: Yotpo earning rules read Recharge's Shopify order tags.

functions.name: Conversation sidebar
functions.yotpo_role: Shows the customer's reviews and loyalty data next to the conversation.
